files.petstore.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Petstore Plus API
  version: 1.2.0
  description: Manage pets, orders and users.
paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      tags: [Pets]
      summary: List available pets
      description: Returns a paginated list of pets.
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of pets to return.
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            default: 20
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/RequestId"
        - name: session
          in: cookie
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A list of pets.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
    post:
      tags: [Pets]
      summary: Create a pet
      requestBody:
        $ref: "#/components/requestBodies/NewPet"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
  /pets/{petId}:
    parameters:
      - name: petId
        in: path
        description: Unique pet identifier.
        schema:
          type: string
    get:
      tags: [Pets]
      summary: Get a pet
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The pet.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
        "404":
          description: Not found.
    delete:
      tags: [Pets]
      summary: Delete a pet
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Deleted.
  /orders/{orderId}:
    patch:
      summary: Update an order
      parameters:
        - name: orderId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            nullable: true
            enum: [placed, shipped]
      responses:
        default:
          description: The updated order.
components:
  parameters:
    RequestId:
      name: X-Request-Id
      in: header
      description: Optional request tracking identifier.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  requestBodies:
    NewPet:
      required: true
      description: The pet to create.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewPet"
  schemas:
    Pet:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
    NewPet:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string

files.api/openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Multi API
  version: "1"
paths:
  /pets:
    $ref: "paths/pets.yaml"
  /status:
    get:
      summary: Service status
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "../shared/common.yaml#/components/schemas/Status"
files.api/paths/pets.yaml:
get:
  tags: [Pets]
  summary: List pets
  parameters:
    - $ref: "../../shared/common.yaml#/components/parameters/Limit"
  responses:
    "200":
      description: Pets
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              $ref: "../schemas/pet.yaml"
files.api/schemas/pet.yaml:
type: object
properties:
  name:
    type: string
files.shared/common.yaml:
components:
  parameters:
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      description: Page size.
      schema:
        type: integer
  schemas:
    Status:
      type: object
